purpose: Define positive and negative canonical fixtures used to test generic readers, validators, projectors and migration tooling against Contract Format 1.4 semantics.

topics.name: Golden Conformance Fixtures
topics.purpose: Define positive and negative canonical fixtures used to test generic readers, validators, projectors and migration tooling against Contract Format 1.4 semantics.

semantics.positive_rule: Positive fixtures encode expected valid semantics and expected normalized/read results.
semantics.negative_rule: Negative fixtures encode one or more explicit expected hard-gate failures.
semantics.golden_rule: Expected results are machine-readable and versioned with the fixture.
semantics.reader_rule: A conforming generic reader should produce semantically equivalent normalized results on positive fixtures.
semantics.validator_rule: A conforming validator should reject negative fixtures for the declared reasons.
semantics.projector_rule: Projection tools may vary visually but must preserve the expected semantic source graph.
semantics.migration_rule: Migration tooling can use fixtures to prevent regressions while old contracts are converted.

invariants.rule: Documentation, diagrams, serializers and projection tools derive from canonical semantics and never become semantic authority by convenience.

hard_gates.condition: fixture expected result exists only in prose
negative fixture passes despite declared hard-gate violation
visual projection modifies expected source semantics
